summary:
Apollo V1 iteration-7 (Quiet hours, Battery saver + Minimise, Family phone/one-tap-call, Patrolling rename, Guard capability/permission sheet split) PASSED. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_quiet_and_phone.py against https://threat-patrol-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api: PUT /api/devices/{id}/settings echoes body; GET returns settings + quiet_now = True for a computed 2h window that brackets 'now', False for a window well away from 'now'; unknown device GET returns quiet_hours.enabled=False; overnight-wrap payload (start 1320, end 420) accepted and quiet_now returns bool. Patrol suppression: growling+background=True inside quiet_hours -> 200 AND backend log contains 'growling push suppressed by quiet hours' (verified via /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log tail); barking+background=True inside quiet_hours -> 200 AND log contains 'owner push failed (non-blocking)' (barking NOT suppressed; upstream 401 due to placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY as expected); growling+background=False -> 200 and no owner-push log emissions. Family: POST /api/family/pair with phone '+61 400 123 456' returns code; phone 'abc' returns 400 'Enter a valid phone number'; phone omitted returns 200. POST /api/family/link then GET /api/family/links?device_id=B shows i_watch[0].phone == '+61 400 123 456' (owner phone). POST /api/family/links/phone with '0411 222 333' overrides; GET links reflects override. Unknown link -> 404. After a barking event on device A, GET /api/family/shared-events?device_id=B items include protected_device_id and phone (guardian override). Frontend (390x844): onboarding label uses 'Patrolling' (no 'Resting'). Home hero title 'Apollo is patrolling' with testID apollo-hero-anim-resting; home-background-card visible with 'Minimise' button (home-minimise). Settings quiet-hours card: settings-quiet-switch toggles the two TimeSteppers (default settings-quiet-start-value '10:00 pm', settings-quiet-end-value '7:00 am'); pressing settings-quiet-start-up -> '10:30 pm' (delta 30m), settings-quiet-end-down -> '6:30 am' (delta 30m); settings-quiet-now pill rendered. settings-lowpower-switch -> Home shows Pill 'Battery saver' with testID lowpower-pill. Patrol tab filter chip reads 'Patrolling' (no 'Resting'). Guard tab: 'What's needed' (guard-cap-site_guard-fix) opens capability-sheet; the perm button (capability-sheet-perm-network_filter) opens permission-sheet with 'Continue' (permission-sheet-continue) -> 'permission granted' text appears. Family: family-owner-phone input, family-make-code creates code (verified once), family-link-code + family-link-button link the seed protected device; family-watch-

row shows phone with family-watch-call-

Call button. After seeding a barking event via /api/patrol/events, family-shared- row appears with family-call- Call button. Direct navigation to /family/alert/ renders family-alert-headline, family-alert-call, family-alert-sms; 'Change number (+61 400 987 654)' (family-alert-edit-phone) -> family-alert-phone input -> family-alert-save-phone -> toast 'Number saved' -> family-alert-ack-called -> toast 'Marked: I called them' -> family-alert-ack-done pill shown. ui_bugs.issue: Pressable 'guard-cap-<id>-press' wraps a Button 'guard-cap-<id>-fix' — React Native Web renders both as <button>, so we get 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' hydration errors and unreliable click routing. Refactor so only ONE element is a button (e.g. render the outer as a View when status is not permission_required, or make the inner 'What's needed' a Pressable/Text-link, or don't render the inner button when the outer Pressable is enabled). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/guard.tsx:72-80

Pressable 'family-shared-<eid>' (that navigates to /family/alert/<eid>) contains a nested Button 'family-call-<eid>'. Tapping the row from the web preview can hit the inner button and auto-fire the tel: link + 'called' ack instead of navigating to the alert detail. Direct navigation to the detail URL works. Same nested-<button> concern as Guard tab. Reference: /app/frontend/app/family.tsx:129-138

issues: 'family-alert-ack-done' pill and 'Change number (…)' both use toLocaleDateString() and phone display — carry-over from iter-6 comment; not blocking. Consider stable date formatting for AU users.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web renders both as <button> — nested-button HTML violation causing hydration warnings and event-bubbling weirdness on web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/guard.tsx:72-80 and /app/frontend/app/family.tsx:129-138.

action_items: Fix nested <button> in Guard tab: refactor guard-cap-<id>-press so the outer Pressable is only interactive when status=='permission_required' AND when interactive, DON'T also render the inner Button 'What's needed' — instead render either the outer OR the inner as the actionable control. This will remove the React DOM hydration error visible on web preview. (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/guard.tsx:72-80)

Fix nested <button> in Family shared-events row: change the outer navigation wrapper to a non-button element (e.g., Pressable with accessibilityRole='link', or make the Call button a plain Pressable+Text) so tapping the row navigates to /family/alert/<eid> instead of activating the inner Call button. (/app/frontend/app/family.tsx:129-138)
Optional: stable date format (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DD' via Intl.DateTimeFormat) for ack-done pill and Change-number label to avoid US-locale ambiguity in AU (carry-over from iter6).
Optional (native only): verify distinct push sounds/channels (channel_id='growling' vs PUSH_THREAT) once EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is a real key in a native build — cannot be exercised in web preview / dev.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L881: device_quiet_now performs an extra Mongo read per patrol event. Fine today; if event rate climbs, cache settings on the Device doc read pipeline or piggy-back on the fanout query.
server.py L339 in_quiet_hours: `end` uses `m < end` (half-open) — a payload with start==end will always return False (empty window). Acceptable default but worth documenting.
server.py L727 _clean_phone: allowed-char set is generous (permits mixes like '+()12--34') and only enforces >=6 digits. Fine for MVP; consider libphonenumber for stronger AU parse.
family.tsx L129-138 and (tabs)/guard.tsx L72-80: nested Pressable+Button pattern violates HTML on web; see UI-bugs section.

family/alert/[id].tsx L64: `tel = alert?.phone`, but alert.phone reflects the guardian override AFTER refetch — the local `phone` state (input value) is refreshed only when `!editing`. If a user opens the input and cancels without saving, phone state can go stale. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all acceptance-criteria testIDs verified; 1 hydration bug found in Guard+Family shared row that affects UX on web only)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test devices only, all prefixed with 'seed7…', 'dev-…', 'iter7…' UUID-suffixed. Backend pytest module and the playwright script both create their own protected devices and pair codes and post their own patrol events; nothing touches seeded blocklist rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend quiet-hours suppression logs to /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log (line 'growling push suppressed by quiet hours' / 'owner push failed (non-blocking)'). Push delivery cannot be exercised end-to-end in dev (EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder → 401 upstream → non-blocking log). When testing Family flow on web, prefer direct navigation to /family/alert/<eid> — tapping the shared row via UI may bubble into the inner Call button until the nested-<button> refactor lands. Use fetch() from inside page.evaluate to seed pair/link/event with the CURRENT session's device_id (JSON.parse(localStorage['apollo.securecore.mock.identity']).deviceId).
rca_of_issue: Nested <button> in Guard capability card and Family shared-event row: React Native Web maps Pressable to <button>, and Button already renders as <button>; wrapping Button inside Pressable produces invalid HTML. Fix in both places by only having ONE clickable element in the tap target (e.g. Pressable outer + Text-link inner, or non-Pressable outer + Button child).
